to entangle, confuse, hamper, trouble, encumber, perplex, complicate
to become or to render flustered, knowing not what to say
to mix up, confuse one for another
to get mixed up (involve oneself in a negative way, romantically or otherwise)
to catch somebody in one’s web (get someone in one’s control)
